description: Utilities for actor-based concurrency. Actors are isolated units of execution that communicate via messages, enabling concurrent and distributed system design.

instructions.description: This function should be used by another actor to spawn a new actor of this type. You need to insert this function into exported function definition.
instructions.name: Spawn actor

parameters.description: Function to be called when message is received
parameters.name: onMessage

parameters.description: Function to be called when request is received
parameters.name: onRequest

instructions.description: Sends message to another actor. A message handler (if defined) will be executed in the context of the receiving actor. If message handler is not defined, message will be ignored.
instructions.name: Send message to actor

parameters.description: ID of the actor to send message to
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Message to send to the actor
parameters.name: message

instructions.description: Requests a value from another actor. A request handler (if defined) will be executed in the context of the receiving actor. If the request handler is not defined, request will be ignored.
instructions.name: Request actor

parameters.description: ID of the actor to send message to
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Message to send to the actor
parameters.name: message

parameters.description: Specifies how long the actor will wait for the response.
parameters.name: timeout

instructions.description: Retrieves ID of the current actor. Useful for debugging or to allow other actors to send messages to this actor.
instructions.name: Retrieve actor ID

instructions.description: Terminates actor. If actor ID is not provided, current actor is terminated.
instructions.name: Terminate actor

parameters.description: Actor ID to terminate. If not provided, current actor is terminated.
parameters.name: id

instructions.description: Checks if actor with provided ID exists. Useful to check if actor is still running.
instructions.name: Check if actor exists

parameters.description: Actor ID to terminate. If not provided, current actor is terminated.
parameters.name: id
